raw.description:
kein klub returns to h0l0 on december 11.

  
3 × 4-hour sets. two rooms.

  
room 1 starts with jon k for four hours, before marie davidson and danny daze meet for their first-ever b2b and take it through to 6am.

  
room 2 belongs to kilopatrah jones. four hours of house + disco, midnight-4am.

  
marie davidson pulls club music apart and rebuilds it in her own image, moving through techno, electro, italo and spoken word with a taste for tension and confrontation.

  
danny daze comes from miami bass and b-boy culture, with detroit techno and dutch electro never far away. his label omnidisc follows the same logic: raw music, strange turns.

  
jon k: mal recordings co-founder and longtime nts presence, moving across eras and genres. jungle, ukg, house, dub and whatever makes sense in the moment.

  
kilopatrah jones: queens-born, house dancer first, dj second. a nowadays resident and lot radio regular, their sets are physical, euphoric and built around the dancers.

  
room 1: jon k 10pm-2am; marie davidson b2b danny daze 2-6am.

  
room 2: kilopatrah jones midnight-4am.

  
kein klub is a recurring club night at h0l0 focused on discovery and raw, off-center club music. monthly residency at h0l0.

  
by aionia - @kein.klub.

  
$1 from every ticket sold goes to badass animal rescue.
